overview_description.description:
Roofr is a marketplace for roofing and utilizes satellite imagery for instant roofing estimates.

A technologically advanced roofing brokerage that uses revolutionary software to simplify roof replacement and repair. At Roofr, they aim to provide the highest quality workmanship and service in the roofing industry. By providing affordable pricing and revolutionary convenience, Roofr emphasizes the importance of customer experience over company profit.

about_short_description.short_description: Roofr is a roofing software platform that offers measurement reports, digital proposals, invoicing, and payment services.

product.name: Roofr CRM
product.description: A roofing business management system for tracking leads, customers, jobs, sales pipelines, tasks, communications, and performance across the project lifecycle.

product.name: Roofr Measurement Reports
product.description: Aerial roof measurement reports that provide roof dimensions, material calculations, structure details, and waste factors for residential and commercial roofing projects.

product.name: Roofr Proposals
product.description: A proposal builder for creating branded roofing quotes and contracts with pricing options, scope details, customer documents, and electronic signatures.

product.name: Roofr Instant Estimator
product.description: A lead-generation and qualification tool that gives homeowners immediate roof estimates based on a contractor’s services, pricing, materials, and project options.

product.name: Roofr Payments & Invoicing
product.description: Integrated tools for creating, sending, tracking, and settling roofing invoices, including online credit card and ACH/EFT payment processing.

product.name: Roofr Material Ordering
product.description: A material procurement tool that generates and sends roofing material orders using report quantities, proposal line items, job details, and supplier integrations.
